name: BtttrTags
description: Adds btttr.cc style hanging tags to original movie & series posters across all clients while keeping original artwork safe.
overview: Adds btttr.cc style hanging tags to original movie & series posters.

versions.changelog:
- Award tags from Wikidata: Oscars, Emmys, Cannes, Venice, Berlin, BAFTAs, Golden Globes, National Film Awards and Filmfare. Winners get a gold tag, nominees a tag in the poster's colour
- Every tag has its own on/off switch, including separate New Movie and New Series, #N Today and Trending, and award winners and nominees
- Trending, New and Just Added now come before IMDb Top 250 and award tags, so a permanent tag never hides them
- Tags use Inter SemiBold at one size relative to the poster, with the same baseline for every tag
- Tagged posters are redrawn once in the new style
- After updating, review the settings page: the tag switches were reorganised and all start switched on

- First public release
- Hanging poster tags for IMDb Top 250 movies and shows, Trending, New Movie, New Series, Just Added, Returning Series and Binge Ready
- Tag colors matched to each poster's artwork, with a gold tag for IMDb Top 250
- Original posters backed up before tagging, and restored when a tag no longer applies
- Runs daily at 04:30, and keeps the last good lists if a download fails
- Restore All Original Posters button for administrators
